page.overview:
Who is Ourea?

The Ourea were the descendants of Gaea and the Protogenoi gods of mountains.

In Hesiod's Theogony, he explained the Ourea like this:

, graceful haunts of the goddess Nymphs who dwell amongst the glens of the hills.

The nine ourea were Aitna, Athos, Helikon, Kithairon, Nysos, Olympus, Oreios, Parnes, and Tmolus and they were the parthenogenetic offspring of Gaia alone. Category:Protogenoi Category:Gods Category:Mountains
